description: The waveforms of a lane's clips on one canvas and one WebGL context, drawn on the GPU by gl-waveform through @audio-ui/gl: the exact lowest and highest sample of every pixel column with the RMS inside, a line through the samples zoomed in, however long the recording. Plain, or as the three bands of the sound one over the other, the lows warm and the highs cool. Nothing without WebGL 2
name: waveform-lane
